from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEPSData(BaseModel):
    """Earnings per share data for one company's 10-Q filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as named in the filing")
    basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="Basic earnings per share amount")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share amount")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    basic_greater_than_diluted: bool | None = Field(description="Whether Basic EPS exceeds Diluted EPS")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_data: list[CompanyEPSData]
